arStrings.szText: While {c_important}{u}Healthy{/u}{/c}, your casts of {c_important}Hydra{/c} gain {c_number}{SF_15}{/c} additional head and deal {c_number}[{SF_25}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage for its duration.

{c_important}Hydra{/c} is bathed in flame, dealing {c_number}{dot:UPGRADE_B_BURN_TOOLTIP}{/c} Burning damage per second to surrounding enemies. 

{c_important}Hydra's{/c} attacks now instead deal {c_number}{dot:UPGRADE_B_HYDRA_BURN_TOOLTIP}{/c} Burning damage over {c_number}[SF_13]{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Hydra{/c} Summons a massive {c_number}1{/c}-headed {c_important}Hydra{/c} that spits explosive fire and deals {c_number}[SF_37*100]%{/c} increased damage for each extra head it would have had. 

{c_important}Hydra{/c} now has a {c_number}[SF_21]{/c} second Cooldown.

{c_important}Hydra{/c} becomes a {c_important}Frost{/c} Skill that deals {c_number}{payload:TOOLTIP_DAMAGE_UPGRADE_C}{/c} Cold damage.

{c_important}Hydra's{/c} attacks pierce enemies and {c_important}{u}Chill{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[{SF_31}|%|]{/c}.
{c_important}Hydra{/c} heals you for {c_number}[SF_47*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax() * SF_47]){/c} each time it deals damage.
{c_important}Hydra{/c} gains {c_number}1{/c} head for every {c_number}3{/c} {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c} you have on Cast.
{c_important}Hydra{/c} reduces the Cooldown of a random Skill by {c_number}[{SF_49}|1|]{/c} seconds whenever it attacks.
{c_important}Hydra{/c} gains {c_number}[SF_50 * 100]%{/c} Cast Speed, but its duration is reduced to {c_number}[SF_51]{/c} seconds.
